title: Book Two · Chapter 156: Mei's Own Page
story:
Mei has a large page on the reading room table. There is no picture on it. Three short notices sit side by side.

Ronan stops beside her. “Are you going to draw the rooms?”

“No. I am reading.”

“For your pictures?”

“For the group.”

She puts a finger under the middle notice. Ronan sees three small questions in her book. Each answer has a line number beside it.

“Did Miss Wu give you those questions?” he asks.

“I wrote them. Jun tries to answer them from the notices. Then I check his answers.”

“Could I try one?”

Mei looks at the clock. “We have ten minutes. You can ask me first.”

Ronan reads the notices. One room opens on Monday and Thursday. Another opens only after lunch. The third needs a teacher at the door.

“Can a younger student use the third room alone?” he asks.

“No. The student needs a teacher.”

“Which teacher?”

“The notice does not say. I need to ask the office.”

He looks again. She is right. The page gives no teacher's name.

“I thought the last name was a teacher.”

“It is the room name.”

Ronan leans closer. The word above it says ROOM. Mei gives him time to see it before she turns the page.

“Your turn,” she says.

She asks about an afternoon when the room is closed. Ronan finds the right notice and answers. Mei asks him to show the date too.

“Why the date?”

“Because this notice is for next week.”

He checks. “Then my answer is only for next week.”

Mei nods and makes a small mark beside her question.

“You like this work?” he asks.

“I want people to use my page. Sometimes a picture helps them. Sometimes I make it smaller. Then I have more room for the words.”

She shows him a drawing in the back of her book. A chair has very long legs and a tiny seat.

“That one cannot help anyone,” Ronan says.

“It helps me enjoy my lunch break.”

Jun comes through the door with three cups of water. He puts one beside Mei and offers another to Ronan.

“Do you want this? I took one too many.”

“Thank you.”

Ronan drinks. Jun sits across from Mei and opens his own page. Ronan moves to the next table. He starts three questions for himself. He forgets to leave space for the first answer.

Mei glances over and slides him another sheet. He takes the sheet and writes a smaller heading. Then he begins again.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

line number＝行号；office＝办公室；heading＝标题；glance＝瞥一眼。

## 理解问题

1. Mei怎样为阅读资料小组做自己的准备？
2. Ronan提出的问题为什么有一个不能直接从通知回答？

## 读句子

**He forgets to leave space for the first answer.**

拆开看：He / forgets / to leave space for the first answer.

他／忘记／为第一个答案留下空间。
